next.reason: 1985: "Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not refer to the same storage area."; 2023: "14.6.10, Overlapping operands, and 14.9.25, MOVE statement, general rules, apply to any cases in which ... share any part". 1985 refuses a RELEASE whose identifier-1 shares storage with record-name-1. 2023 has no such syntax rule and leaves shared storage to the overlapping-operand and MOVE rules.
